name: Glass Houses
description: Everyone lives in a glass house. Everyone throws stones. Last house standing wins.

badges.name: First Stone
badges.description: Break your first pane.

badges.name: Shattered
badges.description: Break 50 panes.

badges.name: Last House Standing
badges.description: Win a round.

badges.name: Glass Half Full
badges.description: Win a round with 10 or more panes left.

badges.name: Not a Scratch
badges.description: Win a round without losing a pane.

badges.name: Interception
badges.description: Knock a stone out of the air.

badges.name: Gnome Run
badges.description: Break 2 panes with one gnome.

badges.name: Fore!
badges.description: Bonk a neighbour.

badges.name: House Proud
badges.description: Win a match.

badges.name: The Whole Street
badges.description: Win a round on all eight streets.

badges.name: Hot Hands
badges.description: Throw a hot stone: three glass hits in a row.

badges.name: Firefighter
badges.description: Knock a hot stone out of the air.

badges.name: Salvage
badges.description: Win a pane back by knocking a house out.

badges.name: Long Shot
badges.description: Break a pane from right across the street.

badges.name: Daily Paper
badges.description: Play the Daily Street.

badges.name: Job Done
badges.description: Finish all three of a day's jobs.

badges.name: Regular
badges.description: Play three days in a row.

badges.name: Neighbourhood Watch
badges.description: Play seven days in a row.

badges.name: Rock Hound
badges.description: Reach level 10.

badges.name: Street Legend
badges.description: Reach level 30.

controls.action: Wind up, let go to throw
